hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys,os; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path',''); root=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR') or os.getcwd(); rel=os.path.relpath(os.path.normpath(os.path.join(root,fp)),root) if fp else ''; rel=rel.replace(os.sep,'/'); members={'CLAUDE.md':'claude','.github/copilot-instructions.md':'copilot','CONTRIBUTING.md':'detail'}; which=members.get(rel) or ('detail' if rel.startswith('architecture/') else None); others={'claude':'.github/copilot-instructions.md, and the rule-level detail in architecture/ or CONTRIBUTING.md','copilot':'CLAUDE.md, and the rule-level detail in architecture/ or CONTRIBUTING.md','detail':'CLAUDE.md and .github/copilot-instructions.md'}; msg=('You edited '+rel+' - MIRROR RULE: CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md and the detail layer (architecture/, CONTRIBUTING.md) are one documentation set. If this change carries a RULE rather than detail-only wording, make the equivalent change in '+others[which]+' before calling it done. First check the rule belongs in an always-loaded file at all: if a CI test already enforces it, neither mirror should carry it.') if which else ''; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PostToolUse','additionalContext':msg}})) if which else None"
